biography.value:
Description

The legendary dragon of the ice and snow has returned but with greater power. Despite her small stature, she's quite dangerous.

Defense

AC 41, touch 27, flat-footed 24 (+14 natural, +16 dex, +1 dodge)

hp 1015 [1334] (29d12+319)

mp 257

Fort +27, Ref +34, Will +28

Absorb Ice; DR 15/magic;

Immune Ability Drain, Berserk, Blind, Charmed, Confuse, Cowering, Death, Diseased, Doom, Energy Drain, Entangled, Exhausted, Fatigued, Frightened, Frog, Immobilized, Imperil, Mini, Nauseated, Panicked, Paralysis, Petrify, Sap, Shadow, Shaken, Silence, Sleep, Slow, Staggered, Stop, Stunned, Zombie

SR 34; Strong Wind

Weakness Fire

Offense

Speed 50 ft., burrow 30 ft., swim 50 ft.

Melee Bite +42 (3d6+19 plus 2d8 ice damage), 2 claws +40 (2d8+13 plus 2d6 ice damage), tail slap +40 (2d8+19 plus 1d8 ice damage)

Special Attacks Absolute Zero, Avalanche, Breath Weapon (70-ft. cone, 24d10 ice damage, Reflex DC 35 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Freeze Fang, , Hailstorm, Northern Cross, Snowstorm

Spells Known (FC CL 29th, concentration +39)

0th (DC 20) - Bleed, Detect Magic, Mending, Message, Read Magic

1st (DC 21) - Blizzard, Frostbite, Icicle Dagger, Slick

2nd (DC 22) - Blizzard II, Elemental Resistance, Frigid Touch, Frost Fall, Icy Breath, Slick II

3rd (DC 23) - Blizzara, Blizzard III, Ice Spears, Sleet Storm, Slick III

4th (DC 24) - Blizzard IV, Ice Spikes, Ice Storm

5th (DC 25) - Blizzaga, Cone of Cold, Freeze, Icy Prison, Wall of Ice

6th (DC 26) - Freezing Sphere, Glacier, Ice Spikes II, Icy Blast

7th (DC 27) - Freeze II, Ice Body

8th (DC 28) - Glacier II, Ice Spikes III, Polar Ray

9th (DC 29) - Iceburg, Mass Icy Prison, Polar Midnight

Statistics

Str 36, Dex 42, Con 32, Int 24, Wis 30, Cha 20

Base Atk +29; CMB +42; CMD 69 (73 vs. trip)

Feats Canny Tumble, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Empower Spell, Great Cleave, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Mobility, Power Attack, Spring Attack

Skills Acrobatics +45, Appraise +40, Bluff +38, Intimidate +38, Knowledge (arcana) +40, Knowledge (geography) +40, Knowledge (history) +40, Knowledge (nature) +40, Perception +43, Sense Motive +43, Spellcraft +40, Stealth +49, Swim +54; Racial Modifiers +8 Swim

Languages Auroran, Common, Draconic

SQ Beatdown, Icewalking, Ice Shape, Icy Death, Mirror Image

effect: [phase i] Ice dragon can shape ice and snow at will. This ability functions as stone shape, but only targeting ice and snow, not stone. Ice dragon's caster level for this effect is equal to its Hit Dice.

description.value: [phase i] This ability works like the spider climb spell, but the surfaces the dragon climbs must be icy. The dragon can move across icy surfaces without penalty and does not need to make Acrobatics checks to run or charge on ice.
[phase i] At the start of the fight as an immediate action, Ice Dragon splits into four. Each Ice Dragon has the exact same stats and abilities as the primary Ice Dragon.

effect: Place four unlinked copies of this actor in total. Each has its own HP, MP, cooldowns and full abilities. Advance all survivors one phase per death.

description.value: [phase i] Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, the Ice Dragon will summon a 30 ft.-radius blizzard in a select area completely freezing all those who fail their Fortitude save (DC 34). Every target can be trapped in solid ice 29 inches thick. If the creature fails its save, it is helpless, but can still breathe (the ice blocks line of effect to the target). If the target makes its save, it gains the entangled condition but can otherwise act normally. Whether or not the target saves, it takes 29 points of ice damage each round it is helpless or entangled in the ice. The ice has hardness 0 and 87 hit points; if broken, the creature is freed. A creature can break the ice as a full-round action with a successful Strength check (DC 39) or Escape Artist skill check (DC 44). Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).

description.value: [phase i] Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, the Ice Dragon will summon a 30 ft.-radius blizzard in a select area completely freezing all those who fail their Fortitude save (DC 34). Every target can be trapped in solid ice 29 inches thick. If the creature fails its save, it is helpless, but can still breathe (the ice blocks line of effect to the target). If the target makes its save, it gains the entangled condition but can otherwise act normally. Whether or not the target saves, it takes 29 points of ice damage each round it is helpless or entangled in the ice. The ice has hardness 0 and 87 hit points; if broken, the creature is freed. A creature can break the ice as a full-round action with a successful Strength check (DC 39) or Escape Artist skill check (DC 44). Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).
